Reading the invoice module.

No. Money is never a float in this codebase, use Decimal and quantize with ROUND_HALF_UP like billing/ledger.py does.
Understood, you're right: the epsilon only moves the boundary. Switching to Decimal and reusing ledger.to_cents.
